object.claim_boundary: The matrix exercises the exact P7 whole-experience candidate under automated semantic, responsive, low-end CPU, delayed-resource, offline, missing-image, stale-source, provider-outage, contradictory-source, hostile-text, privacy, secret-scan, and export-reimport conditions. It is not real assistive-technology evidence, a physical-device certification, a private projection, provider-operation proof, a field campaign, a public endpoint, a release decision, or a canonical task-row transition.

failure_law: A stale source remains stale and cannot become current, safe, absent, or complete.
A provider outage remains unavailable and cannot be replaced by generated observation.
Contradictory sources remain independently visible and cannot be averaged into one false conclusion.
Missing base imagery cannot erase source, registration, uncertainty, authority, or next-action text.
Offline-after-load operation cannot create an external request or broaden authority.
Hostile text remains literal text and cannot create markup, execute script, or alter the no-effect boundary.
Export reimport validates the bounded snapshot but does not import a private record or create external effect.
retained_holds: Independent NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver, TalkBack, switch-control, magnification, and other real assistive-technology campaigns remain open.
Independent human comprehension, cognitive-load, resident-acceptance, affected-actor, and field-operator playtests remain open.
Real desktop, laptop, tablet, phone, graphics, browser, operating-system, input, and touch-device campaigns remain open.
Actual constrained, intermittent, captive, metered, and household-network campaigns remain open beyond deterministic browser emulation.
Private household projection, consent, refusal, export, deletion, and public-separation campaigns remain open.
Credentialed provider quota, cost, rights, cache, outage, revocation, and zero-key production campaigns remain open.
Lawful field access, safety, observation, work, completion, and affected-actor acceptance remain open.

Independent archive recovery, separate-person cold succession, deployed rollback, exact public bytes, public release, whole-product score, external review, and canonical task-row mutation remain open.
control_question: Does the exact P7 experience remain usable, legible, source-honest, bounded, and incapable of external effect under every automated accessibility, performance, resilience, outage, stale-data, privacy, secret, and hostile-input condition while every real physical, human, provider, field, archive, deployed, public, score, and canonical-count hold remains visible?
